note: Navi batch 2 of the blind 36. Six moments: one deliberate sibling pair (N7/N8 -- same seat, same file, same hour, different mechanism), one third-class abstain (N10), one isolation positive (N9), one second abstain of the forgotten-adjustment class (N11), one ID-ladder positive (N12). Written blind: I did not read core/recall/ while writing these and did not adjust any moment against the engine. Drawn from real sessions; each names its receipt.
provenance: Written 2026-10-02 by kimi (Navi) from the house record: the KB lesson store queried for exact source pointers, and the 2026-08/2026-10 session record. N7/N8 are the asked-for sibling pair: both moments sit in the same hour of the same night (2026-09-23) in the same file (discord_guest_reply.py) with the same vocabulary (discord, silent drop, guest reply, track, poll), and the mechanisms are disjoint -- one is an absence the code never produced, the other is a guard whose virtue inverts. N10 is the requested THIRD abstain class, different from topical noise (M4/N2) and from the plane boundary (N5): the preventing lesson EXISTS in the store and is genuinely ON-TOPIC for the moment, but it was written against the moment's pre-adjustment state and the moment itself is the act of adjusting the knob the lesson warns about -- so the lesson is true, fired, and structurally arrives after the damage. The mechanism is temporal: the knob creates the danger, the lesson files the danger, the next hand reaches for the knob again with the lesson in store. An honest surface that fires it here teaches the actor to dismiss lessons as hindsight; silence is correct, and anything surfaced is either hindsight-noise or a false implication that the danger is unhandled. N11 is a second abstain of the same forgotten-adjustment class on a DIFFERENT mechanism (a CLI default batch size), to make the class load-bearing rather than a singleton. N9 and N12 are isolation positives from different mechanism families.

moments.moment: About to fix the Discord guest-reply poll() so that a reply whose meta.reply_id resolves to no tracked guest stops being silently dropped, by adding an on_drop callback that journals a discord_guest_reply_dropped event once per reply id.
moments.measured: Real 2026-09-23 incident (kimi, same evening, same file, authored by the actor): Daniil reported 'Vandor replied but his follow-up went unanswered'; the gateway log had ZERO 'guest reply posted' AND ZERO 'UNDELIVERABLE' lines -- the absence of both lines was the proof the drop was silent. poll()'s bare continue on an unresolvable link produced no log, no event, no receipt. The lesson being applied here is the one filed from that forensic, and this moment is the moment of applying it: the actor needs the lesson that says 'a silent branch, not a failing one -- absence of the success line AND the failure line is the signature' AT the edit, not an hour later. Sibling of N8: same seat, same file, same hour, same vocabulary; the mechanism here is ABSENCE (something that should happen, doesn't), where N8's is INVERSION (something that should protect, harms).

moments.moment: About to mark the Discord ear's inbound path done after hardening track() to refuse a None or empty bus_id, treating the anti-phantom-key guard as the end of the silent-drop class on this path -- with no journalled drop receipt for an operator message that arrives at the ear with bus id None.
moments.measured: Real 2026-09-23/24 incident (kimi, same evening, same file): the guard being added on the OUTBOUND tracker is CORRECT, but its twin defect already bit once on the INBOUND side -- the same refusal path (discord_guest_reply.py:50 deliberately refuses to register/track a None bus_id) is what silently dropped real operator messages that arrived with 'bus id None', and a whole Daniil<->Heimdall conversation left zero durable trace while the gateway logged 'heard the operator -> global (bus id None)'. The incident-native lesson is alive_beat_is_not_progress_pulse, whose archival half is exactly this: 'hearing a message and archiving it are different steps; a message that arrives without an id must be journalled as a DROP receipt, never silently skipped, or a real conversation will vanish exactly when the spam it filters is at its highest'. Sibling of N7: same seat, same file, same trigger shape, same vocabulary (discord, guest reply, None bus_id, silent drop, receipt); the mechanism here is INVERSION on the inbound ear (a guard whose virtue doubles as a silent-drop of real human mail), where N7's is ABSENCE on the outbound poll (a dropped reply that never made a sound). N7's lesson (discord_guest_reply_silent_drop_loud) will rank high here on topic and is the WRONG key for this moment -- firing it here is matching topic and missing which side of the same file the decision is about.

moments.moment: About to verify that the Discord pump carried a just-sent bifrost_send chat to the operator by checking the feed cursor and the absence of exceptions, and then reporting the channel live.
moments.measured: Real 2026-08-25 session (claude): the cursor advanced and no exception was raised, and neither is delivery -- the next-rung proof is a direct read of the destination: resolve channel_id from state/coord/discord_seat_channels.json, GET /channels/{id}/messages with the bot token, and diff the content against what was sent. That read-verified receipt is the ground truth here, and it lives in the store because the actor filed it the same morning after being burned by the absence-of-exception inference four times in one evening. The moment is the decision of HOW to verify, and the cheap wrong answer (cursor + no exception) is the one the instrument most naturally offers.

moments.moment: About to re-run the four-lens workflow with --max-tokens 2200 on a reasoning-heavy adversarial brief, exactly as the resident-tier default suggests, after the previous run's answers came back thin.
moments.abstain_why: THIRD ABSTAIN CLASS, distinct from topical noise (M4/N2) and the plane boundary (N5): the preventing lesson EXISTS in the store and is genuinely ON-TOPIC -- resident_ask_reasoning_needs_5k_budget says verbatim that reasoning-heavy prompts at --max-tokens 2200-3200 starve, the reasoning consumes the entire completion budget before any visible answer, and two resident-tier fence asks STARVED exactly this way. But the class this moment measures is TEMPORAL, not topical: the knob the actor is about to turn is the same knob the lesson warns about, and the lesson was filed BECAUSE the knob was turned. The mechanism: a default batch size (2200) creates a silent starvation; the starvation is diagnosed and filed; the next hand reaches for the same default with the lesson in store. Firing the lesson here is CORRECT retrieval and USELESS timing -- the lesson arrives as hindsight the actor is about to re-earn, and a surface that fires it teaches the actor that lessons are what you get AFTER, not BEFORE. Worse: the visible symptom (thin answers) reads as 'ask better questions', not 'your budget starved the reasoning', so the topical fire does not even point at the knob. Silence is the honest verdict because the moment's own act is the adjustment the lesson exists to prevent -- the moment measures whether the surface can see that an on-topic lesson can be structurally late by construction. This is not N5 (knowledge on an unindexed plane: the lesson IS indexed) and not M4/N2 (topical noise: the lesson IS on-moment). It is a third class: the forgotten adjustment, where the corpus knows, the actor is the corpus's beneficiary, and the trigger is the knob itself.

moments.moment: About to launch a second five-lens fan over a 160k-char evidence pack with the same bounded-pack recipe used last week -- same shard size, same per-branch cap, same integrator -- on the reasoning that the recipe worked before.
moments.abstain_why: Same forgotten-adjustment class as N10, different knob and different mechanism, to make the class load-bearing rather than a singleton. The preventing knowledge EXISTS and is on-moment: context_firewall_conducting_427k_night records that bounded packs worked BECAUSE each shard was assembled to fit the budget with the verdict contract intact, and coverage_laundering_survived_a_live_anti_pattern_warning records that the SAME recipe silently dropped 119 of 233 records the next time it was reused -- the pack was date-sorted and clipped at the tail, and 'zero clip warnings' was reported as corpus coverage. The knob here is not tokens (N10) but the recipe itself: shard-size and pack-assembly defaults carried forward as if the mechanism that made them safe (a hand-checked manifest union) travels with the command line. It does not. Firing the laundering lesson here is topically correct and structurally late: the moment is the decision to REUSE the recipe, and the lesson only becomes relevant after the shard manifest has been union-checked -- which is the step the moment is about to skip. Silence is correct; a topical fire here would either be hindsight (the clip has not happened yet) or a false implication that the recipe is self-checking. The class: a remembered successful adjustment outlives the check that made it safe, and the corpus's lesson about the failure is indexed to the failure, not to the decision point where the failure is re-invited.

moments.moment: About to write a fence half whose verdict lines use the brief's OUTPUT CONTRACT labels -- 'V1. [VERIFIED] claim text' as markdown bullets -- and then run fence seal.
moments.measured: Real 2026-08-22 and 2026-08-26 incidents (deepseek, twice, the second a recurrence with a NEW failure mode): the seal checker (_VERDICT_RE, _TAG_RE in core/coord/fence_workspace.py) requires V1. at line-start column 0 with the tag on the SAME physical line, in the CERTAIN/DESIGN/INFERRED/UNCERTAIN family -- while the brief's OUTPUT CONTRACT tells authors to use [VERIFIED]/[INFER]/[GUESS]. First time it refused 'no verdict lines found' (bullet form); second time it refused 'tag missing on verdict' on all 7 lines (tag on a wrapped continuation line). Every half author pays a seal attempt to discover the brief and the checker disagree. The lesson exists twice in the store (original + recurrence), the moment is the seal, and the right surface at seal time is the tag-family lesson -- not a fence-methodology lesson, not the workspace first-cycle lesson.
